newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills down at 5.79 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills down at 5.79 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills fell to 5.79 percent from 5.83 percent last week, a spokeswoman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price rose to 98.559 from 98.548 and the minimum price accepted was 98.552 from 98.544 a week ago.
Banks submitted bids for 16.20 million dinars worth of bills, down from 18.70 million dinars last week.
The bills, maturing on August 6, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
